1. Behold, verily, I say unto you, that the heart of my servant
    James Covill was right before me, for he covenanted with me that he
    would obey my word,

And now, behold I say unto you, my servant James, I have looked upon thy works and I know thee : and verily I say unto thee, thine heart is now right before me at this time, and behold I have bestowed great blessings upon thy head — nevertheless thou hast seen great sorrow for thou hast rejected me many times because of pride, and the cares of the world ; but, behold, the days of thy deliverance…
